name: Aono Nonoka
source:
The protagonist's sister. She's a first-year. Obedient and docile. She gets good grades in school. Partly due to losing her parents at a young age, she's got a bit of a brother complex- actually, quite a substantial brother complex.

[translated from [url=http://www.pajamas.ne.jp/presis/index.html]official site[/url]]
